record.context_brief: Centrality of the kernel of pi
record.original_question: Let pi: St(V, R) -> PE(V) be the homomorphism from Theorem 2.11(a), and assume the root system R is irreducible of finite rank. Find sufficient conditions under which the kernel Ker(pi) is central.

evidence.quote: 3.3. Centrality of Ker(pi). Let pi : St(V, R) -> PE(V ) be the homomorphism of Theorem 2.11(a). ... The problem here is: find sufficient conditions for Ker(pi) to be central if R has finite rank.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V = (V^+, V^-)$ be a Jordan pair equipped with an idempotent root grading $\Gamma = (V_\alpha)_{\alpha \in R}$ by an irreducible locally finite root system $R$ of finite rank, in the sense of Loos–Neher. Associated with $(V, \Gamma)$ are:

(i) the projective elementary group $\mathrm{PE}(V)$, generated inside the automorphism group of $V$ by the elementary inner automorphisms determined by elements of the root spaces $V_\alpha$; and

(ii) the Steinberg group $\mathrm{St}(V, R)$, defined by generators $x_\alpha(v)$ for $\alpha \in R$ and $v \in V_\alpha$, subject to the additivity relations in each $V_\alpha$ and the standard Steinberg-type commutator relations modeled on those satisfied in $\mathrm{PE}(V)$.

There is a canonical surjective group homomorphism
$$\pi : \mathrm{St}(V, R) \longrightarrow \mathrm{PE}(V)$$
sending each generator $x_\alpha(v)$ to the corresponding elementary automorphism of $V$.

Determine sufficient conditions on the pair $(V, \Gamma)$ (and on the irreducible finite-rank root system $R$) under which the kernel $\ker(\pi)$ is contained in the center of $\mathrm{St}(V, R)$, i.e., conditions guaranteeing that $\pi$ is a central extension.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature establishes centrality and universality of $\ker(\pi)$ when $R$ has infinite rank (or rank $\geq 5$ in some settings), but the finite-rank case is explicitly raised as an open problem requiring sufficient conditions; no comprehensive solution was located.

status_evidence.title: Steinberg groups for Jordan pairs (Neher)
status_evidence.snippet: St(V) is the universal central extension of PE(V) in case Φ is irreducible of infinite rank.
status_evidence.claim: Centrality/universality of the Steinberg covering is established for infinite-rank irreducible root systems, leaving the finite-rank case as the remaining problem.

status_evidence.title: Presentation of affine Kac–Moody groups over rings
status_evidence.snippet: If Φ has rank ≥5 then St(V,Γ) covers uniquely all central extensions of PE(V).
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for rank ≥ 5; general sufficient conditions for centrality in finite rank remain to be identified.
